title: Switch to recent tabs like Alt+Tab
slogan: All your tabs, one key away. Never lose one again.
banner_text: This page is also available in English.
views_label: The switcher, in the view you like
visual_list_text: Each tab with its website address and when you last used it. The tab you used before is already selected.
visual_previews_text: A picture of each tab, to find it at a glance.
visual_icons_text: Only the sites' icons, like switching between apps.
visual_compact_text: Turn on Compact for shorter rows, so more tabs fit at once.
visual_minimal_text: Turn the toolbar off for the simplest switcher.
features_title: Everything about your tabs, in one place
recent_text: The tab you used before is one tap away. Keep tapping to go further back.
search_text: Type a few letters to find any tab by its title or address.
views_text: Pick a compact list, or a grid of previews or site icons.
pages_text: Even on the browser's own pages, where extensions can't go, it opens in a small window of its own.
language_text: Available in 12 languages, including right-to-left ones. It follows your browser's language.
open_text: No account, no ads. The code is on GitHub, under the MIT license.
details_text: Pinned, playing audio and inactive tabs, tab group colors, when you last used a tab and its address: turn each one on or off.
close_text: Close a tab from the switcher with its close button or the middle mouse button. The switcher stays open.
switching_text: Let go of the keys to switch, or keep the switcher open until you choose. Auto-select can open the selected tab by itself.
windows_text: Show the tabs of every window. Those from other windows show their window's number.
theme_text: It follows your device's theme, or you pick light or dark.
shortcuts_text: Alt+S out of the box (Control+S on a Mac). Change the keys, or open it from the toolbar icon.
privacy_text:
Better Tab Switcher works only inside your browser and never connects to the internet: no account, no tracking, nothing sent anywhere.

  • Your settings are saved in your browser, on this computer.
  • With the grid showing Previews, the pictures of your tabs are kept only in memory, never on disk. They are deleted when the tab closes, when you choose Icons instead, or when you close the browser.
  • The sites you visit can't see which tabs you have open.
ctrl_tab_text: Chrome and Microsoft Edge don't let extensions use Ctrl+Tab, so the switcher opens with Alt+S (Control+S on a Mac). The guide explains how to change the shortcut, and how to use Ctrl+Tab with a program that remaps keys.
feedback_link: Report a bug or suggest an idea
